notablePrerequisites:
Hammerfist Giant does not have summoning sickness.
Your life total is at least four greater than each opponent's life total.
description:
Cast Heroic Intervention by paying {1}{G}, giving permanents you control hexproof and indestructible until end of turn.
Activate Hammerfist Giant by tapping it, dealing 4 damage to each creature without flying and each player.
Cacophodon triggers, untapping Hammerfist Giant.
Repeat from step 2.
